name: Endless Monday: In Progress
source:
Penny, our favorite mild-mannered artist and serial procrastinator, has achieved her dream. Now working at a small studio making video games for a living, she's flying high and enjoying life. But as the team struggles to complete their next game, they are faced with impending deadlines, creative differences, and Penny's own bad habits, which threaten to destroy what they worked so hard to build. Now Penny must pull herself together long enough to keep the dream alive, or risk losing it all (and disappointing her mentor). And maybe she'll learn something about herself in the process.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2627590]Steam[/url]]
